quality.review_scope: The supplied main article is the reviewed scope; matching SI is not located or verified. XRD powder, treated graphite SEM and device data are distinct sample contexts without exact batch joins.
missing_fields: No exact reagent masses, total DEG volume, batch scale, copper acetate hydrate, autoclave volume/fill fraction/pressure, heating ramp, agitation or cooling schedule.
No graphite paper grade, dimensions, thickness or supplier; no wash volume, yield, loading or replicates.
No matched SI located in checked local sources; absence is not established.
No source-supplied CIF, unit-cell coordinates or downloadable atomic structure. The ~25 nm value is an XRD Scherrer coherent-domain estimate, not a microscopy particle diameter.
XRD powder and SEM graphite substrate are distinct characterization contexts; no specimen batch identifier joins them.
Only the 5 h condition has phase/SEM structural characterization; 2, 8, 12 h remain device-outcome variants without assigned structure.
conflicts: No conflicting synthesis condition identified in accepted source audit; sample lineage between XRD powder, SEM graphite and devices remains unresolved.
